bank.title: Summarise a long document without losing the detail that matters
bank.hook: A 30-page report lands on your desk an hour before the meeting.
bank.problem: A summary is only useful if you can check it against the source.
steps: Paste or upload the document if your organisation allows it for this tool.
Ask for a summary with the section or page each point came from.
Open the original at those points and confirm the three that matter most.
bank.prompt: Summarise this document in 8 bullet points for a busy manager: [paste text]. After each point, give the section heading or page it came from. Then list 3 questions the document does not answer.
checks: Check the three most important points against the source.
Look for numbers: confirm each one in the document.
bank.mistake: Trusting a summary of a document you have not opened.
bank.privacy: Do not paste customer or company data into an AI tool.
